description: Compatibility endpoint with an x_user_stream-shaped request/response envelope: watches an X account for new posts, translated onto the same underlying monitor system. It exists for migrating an existing x_user_stream-shaped integration without a rewrite. Cost: Free per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/monitoring/oapi-x-user-stream-add-user-to-monitor-tweet

x_user_name.description: The X username to watch, without the @.

name: twitter_x_user_stream_add_user
